name: mkdir

flags.description: Create parent directories as needed; no error if the directory already exists.
Print a message for each created directory.
Set the permission mode (e.g. -m 700) at creation time instead of applying the umask.

examples.explanation: Creates a single directory named photos in the current location.
Creates the full nested path at once, creating any missing parents, and does not complain if parts already exist.

mkdir: created directory 'backup'

examples.explanation: -v confirms each directory that was created.
Creates a directory readable only by its owner, useful for private data.

about: mkdir creates directories with permissions determined by the mode argument (if given) and the umask. With -p it creates every missing component of the path, which makes it ideal for scripts and setup tasks.
useCases: Create project folder structures in one command.
Safely ensure a directory exists in scripts with mkdir -p.
mistakes: Forgetting -p when creating nested paths: mkdir a/b/c fails if a or a/b does not exist.
Trying to create a directory with the same name as an existing file.
warnings: mkdir -p silently succeeds on existing directories, which can hide typos in the path.
